issues.body: `_pr_reachable` still uses `r"uses:\s*\./\.github/workflows/([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)"`, which requires `./.github/workflows/...` immediately after optional whitespace. GitHub Actions accepts quoted YAML scalars such as `uses: './.github/workflows/release.yml'` and `uses: "./.github/workflows/release.yml"`; those edges remain absent from `graph`. A PR-triggered workflow can therefore reach an allowlisted release workflow through a quoted call while `test_no_release_only_workflow_is_reachable_from_a_pr_trigger` stays green, contradicting the asserted fail-closed inertness proof. The added transitive fixture uses unquoted `uses:` on both hops and does not cover the prior-round counterexample.
issues.fix_hint: Recognize both unquoted and correctly closed single- or double-quoted local workflow references, or parse the YAML scalar conservatively. Add regression cases with quoted edges (including a transitive quoted hop) and assert the release workflow is reachable. Ambiguous local `uses:` syntax should fail closed instead of being silently ignored.
issues.title: Reachability scan still misses quoted reusable-workflow calls

verdict.summary: Round 4 is stagnant: the round 3 major finding remains unchanged. The reusable-workflow edge regex still recognizes only unquoted local `uses:` values, so valid single- or double-quoted calls are omitted from the reachability graph. The claimed fail-closed proof therefore remains incomplete, and the new regression fixture still exercises only unquoted edges.
